chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Ash'ari, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Wassa, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abu Baseer, who said:
Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'Give to the sisters from the mother their legislated shares with the grandfather.'
ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of maternal half-sisters when the paternal grandfather is present?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the inheritance share of maternal half-sisters in the presence of the paternal grandfather, affirming that they receive their fixed portion (fariḍah) alongside him. In Shia jurisprudence, this establishes the grandfather's role as a primary heir who does not exclude these sisters, distinguishing the maternal link from the paternal line in the distribution of the estate.
